note: First expansion of the Email Provider Attribution Reference. STRICT SUPERSET of v1: all v1 keys/mappings preserved (EMXP-001,003,005-010 byte-identical; EMXP-002 and EMXP-004 receive ADDITIVE same-provider synonym keys only — no key removed, no mapping altered). Priority-1 candidates from EPR-DATA-002-A added as EMXP-011..016. MX-only; observable provider only; backend never inferred.
backward_compatibility: Every domain mapped under v1 maps to the same provider_id under v2. No v1 attribution key removed; no v1 mapping altered. googlemail.com and the Mimecast regional zones share the existing EMXP-002 / EMXP-004 operator identity so Google/Mimecast domains resolve to one operator (clean THIRD_PARTY_SINGLE), not a fragmented MULTI.

freeze.documentary_verification: Priority-1 set verified 2026-06-23 (EPR-DATA-002-A + provider docs). arsmtp.com=AppRiver(OpenText/Zix) confirmed (AppRiver KB; appriver.com.*.arsmtp.com). messagelabs.com=Symantec Email Security.cloud/Broadcom. mailcontrol.com=Forcepoint. serverdata.net=Intermedia. mimecast-offshore.com/mimecast.co.za=Mimecast regional. hornetsecurity.com=Hornetsecurity. ionos.*=IONOS/1&1. googlemail.com=Google Workspace alt-MX.
freeze.additive_key_determination: ACCEPTED at freeze (founder authorisation). EMXP-002 (+googlemail.com) and EMXP-004 (+mimecast-offshore.com,+mimecast.co.za) carry ADDITIVE synonym keys under the SAME provider_id. Validated against preserved evidence: of 52 googlemail firms, 49 resolve clean THIRD_PARTY_SINGLE Google (EMXP-002); the 3 non-single are GENUINE (woozleresearch.com = Google+Zoho MULTI; chelseafs.co.uk / firstminute.capital = Google + a still-unmapped host, correctly MIXED) — ZERO false MULTI from google/googlemail fragmentation. All 14 mimecast-offshore/.co.za firms resolve to EMXP-004 only. Rejected alternative (separate provider_id) would have fragmented Google/Mimecast.
freeze.revalidation_at_freeze: PASS — schema 16/16, provider_id/key unique, B-1 disjoint, no suffix-nesting, E3 (google.com/outlook.com barred), strict-superset + backward-compat (0 v1 mappings changed/removed), no backend inference. Coverage re-attributed (no re-run): UNDETERMINED 12.5%->8.3%, managed 80.4%->87.4%, gateway 31.2%->34.4%, M365 >=45.5% unchanged.

entries.evidence_source: Microsoft Learn (External DNS records for Microsoft 365): MX = <tenant>.mail.protection.outlook.com; shared path 'mail.protection.outlook.com' identical for every tenant. eTLD+1 outlook.com is shared with consumer mail -> SUFFIX key only (EPR-001 E3). Verified 2026-06-23.

Google Workspace docs: legacy MX = aspmx.l.google.com (+alt1-4); modern single MX = smtp.google.com (since April 2023). Alt-MX hosts aspmx2-5.googlemail.com use the Google-owned registrable domain googlemail.com (eTLD+1) -> ADDED v2 as ETLD1 (provider-owned, NOT the shared google.com which is barred by E3). Corrects ~52 IF-001 firms that were MIXED (google primary mapped, googlemail alt UNMAPPED). Verified 2026-06-23.
Proofpoint hosted email security: MX = *.pphosted.com, *.ppe-hosted.com. Verified 2026-06-23.

Mimecast regional inbound MX: eu/us-smtp-inbound-*.mimecast.com; Offshore (Jersey) je-smtp-inbound-*.mimecast-offshore.com; South Africa *.mimecast.co.za. Offshore/SA zones ADDED v2 (same provider_id; corrects Mimecast undercount). Verified 2026-06-23.
Cisco Secure Email (cloud) MX under iphmx.com. Verified 2026-06-23.
Proton MX = mail.protonmail.ch, mailsec.protonmail.ch. Watch: proton.me. Verified 2026-06-23.
Zoho Mail MX = mx.zoho.com / mx2.zoho.com / mx3.zoho.com and regional mx.zoho.eu, mx.zoho.in. Further regional TLDs are a v2 watch. Verified 2026-06-23.
Barracuda ESS MX = <id>.ess.barracudanetworks.com (registrable domain barracudanetworks.com is provider-specific). Verified 2026-06-23.
Rackspace Email MX = mx1.emailsrvr.com, mx2.emailsrvr.com. Verified 2026-06-23.
Broadcom/Symantec Email Security.cloud (formerly MessageLabs): inbound MX = clusterN.<region>.messagelabs.com (e.g. cluster8.eu.messagelabs.com). Broadcom KB. Verified 2026-06-23.

Hornetsecurity Spam & Malware Protection: inbound MX under hornetsecurity.com. (Note: the antispameurope/arsmtp lineage is distinct — arsmtp.com = AppRiver, EMXP-013, NOT Hornetsecurity.) Verified 2026-06-23.

AppRiver hosted email security: dynamic MX = <domain>.<n>.<id>.arsmtp.com (AppRiver KB 'Dynamic MX Records'; e.g. appriver.com.2.0001.arsmtp.com). AppRiver -> Zix (2019) -> OpenText (2021). Documentary correction at EPR-DATA-002-A: arsmtp.com is AppRiver, not Hornetsecurity. Verified 2026-06-23.

IONOS/1&1 hosted mail: MX = mx00/mx01.ionos.{com,co.uk,de} (alternatively mx00/mx01.1and1.com); legacy 1&1 mx00/mx01.kundenserver.de. IONOS Help (adjusting MX records). All listed are IONOS/1&1-owned registrable domains. Verified 2026-06-23.
Intermedia hosted Exchange: MX = mx1/mx2.smtp.exchNNN.serverdata.net (HostPilot). Intermedia support docs. Verified 2026-06-23.
Forcepoint Email Security Cloud: inbound MX = <customer>.in.mailcontrol.com (Forcepoint help — MX records). Verified 2026-06-23.
